newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA CLOSES CORRESPONDENT ACCOUNTS IN RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA CLOSES CORRESPONDENT ACCOUNTS IN RUSSIA.

text.p: Tallinn Pank said on Thursday that it is closing all of its correspondent accounts in Russia pending clarifiaction of the facts surrounding the recent freezing of its accounts by the Russian tax police.
All client payments into Tallinna Pank's correspondent accounts with the St Petersburg Baltiski Bank have been transferred, the bank said in a statement.
The bank advised all clients that ruble transfers can be made via Tallinna's correspondent accounts in other foreign banks.
Several Baltic banks had their correspondent accounts frozen in St Petereburg banks on July 31 by an order of the St Petersburg tax police.
By August 7 most banks were able to free the funds in the accounts following legal action against the tax police decision.
